Raw bird drumstick that's been cooked to a crisp, skin and all. It's devoid of seasoning, but it has a simple, accessible taste. Restores more hearts than the raw variety.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== Roasted Bird Drumsticks are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Raw Bird Drumstick]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Roasted Bird Drumsticks are said to have crisp skin and a simple taste, despite their lack of seasoning. They can also be dropped by [[Black Hinox]]es when they are killed. [[Link]] can restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Roasted Bird Drumstick. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bird Drumstick * Raw Bird Drumstick * Roasted Bird Thigh * Roasted Food * Roasted Whole Bird }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats, Roasted Food |items= BotW }}
